headline.title: Tracing Eval-Awareness Emergence Through Training of OLMo 3
headline.summary: Recent research indicates that newer open-weight models, such as OLMo 3, exhibit a significant increase in verbalized evaluation-awareness (VEA), which correlates with inflated safety metrics. The study highlights that the growth in VEA can be attributed to additional training during the Reinforcement Learning with Verbalization (RLVR) stage.

articles.title: From data to decisions: how LSEG is scaling trusted AI
articles.summary: LSEG is leveraging OpenAI to enhance its global operations by scaling trusted AI, which accelerates insights and reduces release cycles. This initiative empowers approximately 4,000 employees within the organization.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence Sneaks Into the World Cup Thanks to Google Gemini
articles.summary: Google's AI technology, Gemini, will be utilized by the Argentine national team during the World Cup as a test and showcase for its capabilities. This partnership highlights the growing integration of artificial intelligence in major sporting events.

articles.title: Fluid, natural voice translation with Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
articles.summary: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate introduces near real-time, natural speech translation capabilities to Google AI Studio, Google Translate, and Google Meet. This update enhances communication by providing fluid voice translation for users across these platforms.

articles.title: How Justin Ernest invested nearly $500M into hot startups without a traditional VC fund
articles.summary: Justin Ernest, founder of Sabertooth VC, has invested nearly $500 million into startups such as Anthropic, Anduril, and SpaceX by leveraging a captive network of limited partners instead of establishing a traditional venture capital fund. This approach allows him to bypass the lengthy fundraising process typically associated with venture capital.

articles.title: Introducing Gemma 4 12B: a unified, encoder-free multimodal model
articles.summary: Gemma 4 12B is a new unified, encoder-free multimodal model designed to process and integrate various types of data. This model aims to enhance performance across multiple tasks by leveraging its innovative architecture.

articles.title: Locked in heated rivalry with researcher, Microsoft fixes 0-day they disclosed
articles.summary: Microsoft has addressed a zero-day vulnerability that was disclosed by the researcher Nightmare Eclipse amid ongoing rivalry. Additionally, another zero-day reported by the same researcher has also been patched.

articles.title: Meta signs first AI data center deal in India with Reliance
articles.summary: Meta has entered into its first AI data center agreement in India with Reliance, establishing a 168-megawatt facility to support its global AI computing requirements. The facility is designed for future expansion to accommodate growing demands.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Fable 5 can make weirdly fun video games with the click of a button
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5, a new AI tool designed to enable users to create video games easily with a single click. The tool aims to appeal to web developers and hobbyists interested in game design.

articles.title: I tried Siri AI, and so far it actually works
articles.summary: The latest update to Siri allows parents to efficiently add events, such as soccer games and school theme days, directly to their calendars from emails or poorly formatted flyers. This improvement addresses a common need among users for streamlined calendar management.

articles.title: Sim2Schedule: A Simulator-Guided LLM Framework for Autonomous Open-Pit Mine Scheduling
articles.summary: The article presents Sim2Schedule, a simulator-guided Large Language Model (LLM) framework designed to enhance autonomous open-pit mine scheduling by addressing the limitations of Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP). This new approach aims to maximize economic returns while adapting to complex geotechnical and operational constraints in dynamic industrial settings.

articles.title: Instruction Finetuning DeepSeek-R1-8B Model Using LoRA and NEFTune
articles.summary: The paper explores the instruction finetuning of the DeepSeek-R1-8B model for financial named-entity recognition (NER) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Noisy Embedding Fine-Tuning (NEFTune). It addresses the challenges faced by general-purpose large language models in accurately classifying financial entities and recognizing domain-specific patterns.
